## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Oct 1, 2026 - Oct 6, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _K “K9 Hikes” Lynn_, Oct 4, 2026, 1/5: "App was ok. But the $ 55.82 undisclosed (at least not in an obvious way) renewal charge was not! I reached to cancel the subscription and request a refund, as I wasn't especially impressed by the app content. I got several pushbacks about the refund telling me it's not in their policy, until I initiated a dispute with my credit card company and let the support service know that I'd be leaving a not very good review online about the company. And just like that, I got a refund. Buyer beware!!!"
            2. _Tania Clark_, Oct 1, 2026, 1/5: "Another one of these apps you trust and then realise the so called trial for $10 is nto what gets charged the following month. I cancelled this plan over a month ago and even deleted the app and if you view my account you will notice I never used it. Now I have had huge amounts taken off my account and now for two packages namely for $55.882 and $29.99 and I most definitely would not approve this kind of money transaction. This is fraud and I will report it as such"
            3. _Sani Tsvetanova_, Oct 6, 2026, 2/5: "I requested to cancel my subscription, and my request was granted without any issues. I was assisted by Emily Brooks from the Wellness Support team, and I thank her for that. Naturally, I was offered alternatives and other options, but I declined them. Emily Brooks was not pushy at all—unlike many customer service representatives at various companies—and I appreciate that. My issue was resolved very quickly and without any unnecessary stress."
<!--/ir-theme-->
